Figure 7.12: Interaction between states
7.4.5 State Transition
State Management
can request to change one or several
Function Group
States
(including the
Machine State
), using
ara::exec::StateClient
API.
ara::exec::StateClient::SetState
allows
State Management
to request
several
Function Group State
changes in parallel. If
Machine State
change is
required,
ara::exec::FunctionGroup
has to be created using an
ara::core::
InstanceSpecifier
which is mapped to the
ModeDeclarationGroupProto-
type
representing
MachineFG
.
